title: pvVTKHDFReader
body:
## pvVTKHDFReader

Reads VTK's HDF5-based VTKHDF format (.vtkhdf, .hdf): image data, polydata, unstructured grids, overlapping AMR, hyper-tree grids, partitioned collections and multiblock data, including transient data stored in one file. MergeParts (ParaView default true) merges partitioned pieces into one dataset. Several files in FileName form a time series. Choose it for large VTK data written by vtkHDFWriter or simulation codes; use the XML readers (pvXMLUnstructuredGridReader and others) for .vtu/.vtp-style files.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- All files in a series must store the same data type.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this reader, so inspect the output blocks, arrays and time steps on your own files before relying on it.

Native constructor: `VTKHDFReader`. Identity: `sources/HDFReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CellArrayStatus` | Select the cell arrays to read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `FileName` | The list of files to be read by the reader. Each file is expected to be in the VTKHDF data format storing the same data type. The standard extension is .vtkhdf. If more than one file is specified, the reader will switch to file series mode and provide one file per time step. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"items":{"minLength":1,"type":"string"},"minItems":1,"type":"array"}` | `required` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `MaximumLevelsToReadByDefaultForAMR` | The number of levels that the reader can read when the data type is AMR. Set this to 0 to imply no limit. Default is 0. | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `MergeParts` | Make the reader merge parts in the input data set. If false, the reader will output a partitioned data set. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `PointArrayStatus` | Select the point arrays to read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `UseCache` | Enable the internal reader cache allowing to not re-read data from previous time step if possible. Best used with MergeParts disabled for memory efficiency. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvVTKHDFReader",
  "options": {
    "FileName": [
      "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
    ]
  }
}
```
